summary.en: The persistent frame of a phosphor film and the engine of its scenes: brand mark, name and tag, licence, chapter mark and section, a progress bar and corner brackets, over the drifting ground and under the CRT screen.
summary.zh: phosphor 片子一直在的画框，也是它所有场景的引擎：品牌标记、名称和版本、许可、章节号与小节名、进度条和四角括号，压在漂移的底色之上、CRT 屏幕之下。

fits: Every scene of a phosphor film.
notFor: Films that are not a terminal; a frame that must carry more than five fields.

intent.en: The frame says this is one terminal session and where you are in it: the tool, its licence, the chapter, how far along.
intent.zh: 画框说明这是同一个终端会话、看到了哪：哪个工具、什么许可、第几章、走到多远。

content.en: Brand name (≤ 14), tag (≤ 12), licence (≤ 24), chapter mark ([01/03], [>>], [00]) and section (≤ 24), progress 0–1.

fits.zh: phosphor 片子的每一个场景。

notFor.zh: 不是终端风的片子；要放五个以上字段的画框。

en: Scenes draw the frame only when given `hud` (an optional slot): a host that leaves it out gets a bare screen.
zh: 场景只在给了 hud（可选槽位）时画画框：宿主不给，画面就没有边框。

source.path: assets/templates/phosphor/index.html (HUD, ground, screen CSS); film.js (LOGO, decode, typing, windows); fx.js

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
